label: Chapter 05

sentences.en: The only real test of intelligence is if you get what you want out of life.
sentences.zh: 检验智力的唯一真正标准，是你能否从生活中得到你想要的东西。

sentences.en: – Naval Ravikant
sentences.zh: —— 纳瓦尔·拉维坎特

sentences.en: There is a formula for success.
sentences.zh: 成功有一个公式。

sentences.en: One ingredient is agency.
sentences.zh: 第一个要素是行动力。

sentences.en: One ingredient is opportunity (which many people like to mistake as "privilege" – because they the other ingredients).
sentences.note: 原文英文句此处缺少动词（应为 they lack / don't have 之类），按原样保留未作修正；译文按文意补出“缺少”以便理解。
sentences.zh: 一个要素是机会（很多人喜欢把它误认为是“特权”——因为他们缺少其他要素）。

sentences.en: The last ingredient is intelligence.
sentences.zh: 最后一个要素是智力。

sentences.en: If you have high agency but low opportunity, it doesn't matter how likely you are to act toward a goal, because it isn't a goal that will bear much fruit.
sentences.zh: 如果你行动力很强，但机会很少，那么你朝目标行动的可能性再大也没用，因为那不是一个能带来多少成果的目标。

sentences.en: If you have opportunity and agency but low intelligence, then you will never be fully able to benefit from that opportunity.
sentences.zh: 如果你既有机会又有行动力，但智力不足，那么你永远无法充分利用那个机会。

sentences.en: First, we've talked about agency before here.
sentences.zh: 首先，行动力我们之前在这里已经谈过。

sentences.en: In terms of opportunity, I can't tell you to change your physical location, but if you don't see the abundance of digital opportunity right in front of you, I don't know what to tell you.
sentences.zh: 至于机会，我不能告诉你去改变你的居住地，但如果你看不到摆在你面前的海量数字机会，我也不知道该对你说什么了。

sentences.en: With that said, I want to focus on what intelligence is in the context of these two other ingredients and this letter.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，我想把重点放在智力上——放在它与另外两个要素、以及这封信的关系上。

sentences.en: For that, we look to cybernetics.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们要借助控制论。

sentences.en: Cybernetics comes from the greek word kybernetikos which means "to steer" or "good at steering."
sentences.zh: 控制论（cybernetics）来自希腊语 kybernetikos，意思是“掌舵”或“善于掌舵”。

sentences.en: It's also known as "the art of getting what you want."
sentences.zh: 它也被称为“得到你想要的东西的艺术”。

sentences.en: So, if Naval's definition of intelligence is getting what you want out of life, understanding cybernetics is imperative.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果按纳瓦尔对智力的定义——从生活中得到你想要的东西，那么理解控制论就至关重要。

sentences.en: Cybernetics illustrates the properties of intelligent systems.
sentences.zh: 控制论阐明了智能系统的特性。

sentences.en: To have a goal.
sentences.zh: 有一个目标。

sentences.en: Act toward that goal.
sentences.zh: 朝着目标行动。

sentences.en: Sense where you are.
sentences.zh: 感知自己身处何处。

sentences.en: Compare it to the goal.
sentences.zh: 把它与目标作比较。

sentences.en: And act again based on that feedback.
sentences.zh: 并根据反馈再次行动。

sentences.en: You can judge intelligence based on the system's ability to iterate and persist with trial and error toward a goal.
sentences.zh: 你可以根据一个系统通过试错、不断迭代并坚持朝着目标前进的能力，来判断它的智力水平。

sentences.en: A ship blown off course that corrects toward its destination.
sentences.zh: 一艘被吹偏航向、又修正航向驶向目的地的船。

sentences.en: A thermostat sensing a change in heat and adjusting to reach the desired temperature.
sentences.zh: 一个感知到温度变化、并调节以达到设定温度的恒温器。

sentences.en: What does this have to do with getting what you want out of life?
sentences.zh: 这和从生活中得到你想要的东西有什么关系？

sentences.en: Everything.
sentences.zh: 一切都与此有关。

sentences.en: Acting, sensing, comparing, and understanding the system from a meta-perspective is fundamental to how intelligence is measured.
sentences.zh: 行动、感知、比较，并从元视角理解整个系统，是衡量智力的根本。

sentences.en: High intelligence is the ability to iterate, persist, and understand the big picture.
sentences.zh: 高智力就是能够迭代、坚持，并理解大局。

sentences.en: The mark of low intelligence is the inability to iterate, the inability to persist, and being blind to the big picture.
sentences.zh: 低智力的标志是无法迭代、无法坚持，并且对大局视而不见。

sentences.en: Low-intelligence people get stuck on problems rather than solving them.
sentences.zh: 低智力的人遇到问题就卡住了，而不是去解决问题。

sentences.en: They hit a roadblock and quit.
sentences.zh: 他们一遇到障碍就放弃。

sentences.en: Or they quit, or they just don't see the problem.
sentences.zh: 或者他们放弃了，或者他们根本看不到问题。

sentences.en: High intelligence is realizing any problem can be solved on a large enough timescale.
sentences.zh: 高智力就是认识到：只要时间尺度足够大，任何问题都能解决。

sentences.en: The reality is that the problem hasn't been solved yet because nobody has applied a combination of iteration and persistence to it.
sentences.zh: 现实是，这个问题至今没有被解决，是因为还没有人把迭代和坚持结合起来应用到它上面。

sentences.en: Intelligence is realizing that there is a series of choices you can make which lead to achieving the goal that you want.
sentences.zh: 智力就是认识到：有一系列选择可以做出，它们会引领你实现你想要的目标。

sentences.en: (In the health context, you have a goal of losing weight.
sentences.zh: （在健康方面，你的目标是减肥。

sentences.en: That goal can be achieved with a series of sub-goals that are the equivalent of "eat 1,500 calories" every day, which leads to a series of sub-goals that help you achieve each of those sub-goals, and so on.)
sentences.zh: 这个目标可以通过一系列子目标来实现，比如每天“吃 1,500 卡路里”，而这又会引出一系列子目标，帮助你实现每一个子目标，以此类推。）

sentences.en: When I talk about "goals," and as I will continue repeating, I am not speaking from the typical lens of "goal-setting" or "manifestation."
sentences.zh: 当我说“目标”时——我还会继续重复这一点——我不是从通常的“目标设定”或“显化”的角度来说的。

sentences.en: Instead, I am speaking from a systems level.
sentences.zh: 相反，我是从系统层面来说的。

sentences.en: I am speaking from the lens of teleology or the Greek kosmos – that everything serves a purpose.
sentences.zh: 我是从目的论的角度，或者说希腊语 kosmos（宇宙秩序）的角度来说的——万物皆有其目的。

sentences.en: That every action, movement, and even something as simple as a molecule, is a goal-oriented system.
sentences.zh: 每一个行动、每一次运动，甚至像一个分子这样简单的东西，都是一个以目标为导向的系统。

sentences.en: Goals determine how you see the world.
sentences.zh: 目标决定了你如何看待世界。

sentences.en: Goals determine what you consider "success" or "failure."
sentences.zh: 目标决定了你把什么看作“成功”或“失败”。

sentences.en: You can try to "enjoy the journey," but if you pursue the wrong goal, you will not enjoy it.
sentences.zh: 你可以试着“享受过程”，但如果你追求的是错误的目标，你就不会享受它。

sentences.en: Your mind is the operating system for reality.
sentences.zh: 你的大脑是现实的操作系统。

sentences.en: That system is composed of goals.
sentences.zh: 这个系统由目标构成。

sentences.en: For most people, those goals are assigned to them.
sentences.zh: 对大多数人来说，那些目标是别人强加给他们的。

sentences.en: Programmed like lines of code in your psyche.
sentences.zh: 就像写进你心灵里的一行行代码一样被编好了程序。

sentences.en: Go to school.
sentences.zh: 上学。

sentences.en: Get the job.
sentences.zh: 找工作。

sentences.en: Get offended.
sentences.zh: 动不动就被冒犯。

sentences.en: Play victim.
sentences.zh: 扮演受害者。

sentences.en: Retire at 65.
sentences.zh: 65 岁退休。

sentences.en: A known path that doesn't work.
sentences.zh: 一条行不通的已知路径。

sentences.en: To become more intelligent, you must:
sentences.zh: 要变得更聪明，你必须：

sentences.en: Reject the known path
sentences.zh: 拒绝已知的路径

sentences.en: Dive into the unknown
sentences.zh: 潜入未知

sentences.en: Set new, higher goals to expand your mind
sentences.zh: 设定新的、更高的目标，以扩展你的思维

sentences.en: Embrace the chaos and allow for growth
sentences.zh: 拥抱混乱，允许成长

sentences.en: Study the generalized principles of nature
sentences.zh: 研究自然的普遍原理

sentences.en: Become a deep generalist
sentences.zh: 成为一名深度通才

sentences.en: I understand this may not be the traditional definition of intelligence, but that sequence of steps is what most of us call "learning."
sentences.zh: 我明白这可能不是智力的传统定义，但这一系列步骤正是我们大多数人所说的“学习”。

sentences.en: And it's what you should strive for every day.
sentences.zh: 而这正是你每天都应该努力去做的。

sentences.en: That leads us into the next section perfectly.
sentences.zh: 这正好把我们完美地引向下一节。

title_en: V – Intelligence is the ability to get what you want out of life
title_zh: 五、聪明，就是能从生活中得到你想要的东西

vocab.def_zh: 控制论；研究系统如何通过反馈来调节、达成目标的学科。
vocab.example_en: Cybernetics studies how systems use feedback to reach a goal.

vocab.def_zh: 目的论；认为事物存在皆有其目的的学说。
vocab.example_en: Teleology is the idea that things exist for a purpose.
Good writers iterate on a draft until it works.
A childhood memory can stay in the psyche for years.

vocab.def_zh: 通才；涉猎广泛的人（反义词 specialist，专家）。
vocab.example_en: A generalist learns the basics of many fields instead of mastering only one.
